review.summary: Aprilia lead the constructors' standings after 17 rounds with eight wins and 31 podiums. Jorge Martin tops the riders' championship while Marco Bezzecchi sits third, with Ai Ogura fourth and Raul Fernandez seventh completing a strong roster; Lorenzo Savadori has yet to score. In Indonesia all four Aprilia riders finished on the podium, Bezzecchi taking the win ahead of Fernandez, Martin and Ogura.
review.lastRace: Marco Bezzecchi won the Grand Prix of Indonesia, his round-17 victory joined by a clean sweep as Raul Fernandez finished second, Jorge Martin third and Ai Ogura fourth — all four Aprilia machines on the podium.

review.summary: Ducati are the 2nd-ranked manufacturer in MotoGP after 17 rounds, with 7 wins and 13 podiums. Marc Marquez is their best-placed rider, 2nd overall.
review.lastRace: At the Grand Prix of Indonesia, Marc Marquez finished 6th; Alex Marquez finished 7th; Fabio Di Giannantonio finished 8th; Franco Morbidelli finished 14th; Francesco Bagnaia did not finish (OUTSTND); Fermin Aldeguer did not finish (OUTSTND).

review.summary: KTM are third in the constructors' standings after 17 rounds with two wins and seven podiums. Pedro Acosta is their best-placed rider in fifth, well clear of Enea Bastianini eleventh and Brad Binder thirteenth; Maverick Viñales, Pol Espargaro and Jonas Folger sit further down the order having scored little.
review.lastRace: Pedro Acosta finished fifth at the Grand Prix of Indonesia to claim 11 points, with Enea Bastianini tenth and Brad Binder thirteenth adding more, while Maverick Viñales finished seventeenth without scoring.

review.summary: Honda remain fourth in the constructors' standings after 17 rounds without a win or podium. Luca Marini lead their riders in twelfth with 108 points, ahead of Diogo Moreira fifteenth and Johann Zarco seventeenth; Joan Mir eighteenth and the rest have struggled to reach the front.
review.lastRace: At the Grand Prix of Indonesia Luca Marini finished twelfth for four points, Johann Zarco thirteenth for three, while Diogo Moreira closed out the group in sixteenth without adding any points.

review.summary: Twentieth with just 3 points from 17 rounds and no wins or podiums, well behind team-mate Lucas Di Grassi, who has one win. At the London E-Prix he finished seventeenth after starting eighteenth.

Max Verstappen led from pole to win for Red Bull, just ahead of Charles Leclerc (Ferrari), who took second with the fastest lap, with Mercedes' Andrea Kimi Antonelli third. McLaren's Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri ran fourth and fifth, Lewis Hamilton sixth. George Russell climbed from nineteenth to ninth while Isack Hadjar made a similar drive from twenty-second to tenth.
highlights: Isack Hadjar climbed from twenty-second on the grid to finish tenth for one point.
Charles Leclerc recorded the fastest lap while finishing second for Ferrari.
Alexander Albon, Lance Stroll, Franco Colapinto and Gabriel Bortoleto all retired without scoring points.

review.summary: Marco Bezzecchi won the Grand Prix of Indonesia for Aprilia Racing, with Raul Fernandez of SuperFile Trackhouse finishing second and team-mate Jorge Martin third, giving Aprilia a 1-3 on the podium. Marc Marquez finished sixth for Ducati Lenovo after Francesco Bagnaia and Fermin Aldeguer retired, while Yamaha's Toprak Razgatlioglu and Jack Miller also did not finish.
highlights: Marco Bezzecchi won the Grand Prix of Indonesia for Aprilia Racing, taking the race victory and 25 points.
Raul Fernandez finished second for SuperFile Trackhouse and Jorge Martin third for Aprilia Racing on the podium.
Francesco Bagnaia, Fermin Aldeguer, Toprak Razgatlioglu and Jack Miller all failed to finish without scoring a point.

review.summary: Taylor Barnard won for DS Penske from sixth on the grid, just ahead of a Mahindra one-two as Nyck De Vries took second from pole and Edoardo Mortara third from second. The classification shows front-row starters struggling later, with Pascal Wehrlein dropping from third to fourteenth and Nico Müller slipping from fourth to twelfth.
highlights: Oliver Rowland made the biggest climb of the race, moving from seventeenth on the grid to ninth for three points.
Front-row starters faded, with Pascal Wehrlein dropping from third to fourteenth and Nico Müller slipping from fourth to twelfth.
Joel Eriksson failed to finish from fifteenth on the grid, while Lucas Di Grassi retired from twentieth.
